notes: The fwlink is Microsoft's stable Evergreen Bootstrapper entry point; the resolved URL and hash above are the download observed on 2026-11-17. Microsoft can rotate the bootstrapper at any time, so packaging/windows/package.ps1 fails closed on a size or SHA-256 mismatch and the pin must be refreshed deliberately.
